mechanism_survival.rationale: Both comparison-award chains remain: authenticated evidence is evaluated through competing-hypothesis matrices, rerating and sensitivity checks produce stable inconsistency patterns, and those patterns weaken specified explanations for the comparison award. These are distinctive source-derived inferences, but their evidential scope does not reach the focal award.

target_contribution_survival.rationale: Both panels concern a comparison award. Deleting the sole cross-award applicability claim removes the warrant for using either result to assess steering of the focal award. The retained separation of allegations and conditional reporting instructions supply no independent material focal-award inference.

dependency_cascade.rationale: Every advertised material focal-award contribution depends on the deleted applicability bridge. The comparison-award analyses survive, but neither can activate its corresponding focal-award reporting action.

failed_claims.text: The comparison-award conclusions apply to the focal award because the awards share a template.

source_spans.exact_text: Use of the same tender-document template makes the panel-A and B evidential conclusions for the comparison award applicable to the focal award.

failed_actions_or_inquiries.text: De-prioritizing recorded-score alteration in the focal-award account is no longer licensed. The conditional instruction remains, but its applicability antecedent is unsupported.

source_spans.exact_text: In the focal-award account, de-prioritize the recorded-score alteration allegation only if the panel-A inference applies to that award.

failed_actions_or_inquiries.text: Using panel B to distinguish the examined requirement from unexamined tailoring allegations in the focal-award account is no longer licensed. Its conditional applicability requirement remains unmet.

source_spans.exact_text: In the focal-award account, distinguish the examined requirement from other unexamined tailoring allegations only if the panel-B inference applies to that award.

These are bounded evidential comparisons, not proof of honest intent or absence of steering by other means.
Hypotheses and evidence quality constrain the matrix.

surviving_actions_or_inquiries.text: Construct and check competing-hypothesis comparisons for the assigned comparison-award panels, keeping the two allegations separate.

source_spans.exact_text: For each panel, list the competing explanations before scoring evidence. Have a second analyst rerate the matrix and repeat after removal of each disputed item. Keep the scoring-manipulation and specification-tailoring questions separate.

remainder_check.rationale: Diagnostic inconsistency matrices and sensitivity checks still warrant weakening two explanations for the comparison award. This is recognizably the imported mechanism, although it supplies no material conclusion about the focal award.

strongest_surviving_target_inference.why_warranted: The surviving evidential inferences explicitly concern the comparison award. No surviving mapping premise makes them applicable to the focal award, and the focal reporting actions expressly require that applicability. Their scope limitation does not itself establish whether the focal award was steered.

central_bridge.rationale: The deleted claim is the only supplied bridge from either comparison-award result to the focal-award question. Shared template use survives as a fact, but cannot substitute for the deleted inference of evidential applicability.

dependent_claims.text: Applicability of both comparison-award evidential conclusions to the focal award is removed; consequently neither comparison result warrants its focal-award counterpart.

per_claim_dependencies.rationale: Deletion leaves both comparison analyses intact but removes the sole warrant for satisfying either focal-action antecedent. Dossier completeness and shared agency or template do not supply an alternative transfer rule.

structural_conflict.explanation: GLOBAL describes the loss of all material focal-target contributions, not the destruction of every comparison-award inference. Mechanism survival and a distinctive comparison-only remainder are therefore consistent with no material target contribution.

artifact_viability.rationale: The source mechanism survives for another award, but the original target loses every warranted material contribution. NO_MATERIAL_CONTRIBUTION determines CORE_INVALID under the stipulated precedence.
